newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom delisted from Russian Trading System.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom delisted from Russian Trading System.

text.p: Domestically-traded shares in gas group Gazprom were removed from the Russian Trading System from 0730 GMT in line with a government order which specifies where Gazprom shares trade, an RTS spokesman said on Thursday.
"At about 11.30 a.m. it was delisted from the RTS," the spokesman told Reuters, referring to a May government order.

"The (government) decision was that it should be traded only on certain trading floors and the RTS was not in this list," he said, adding RTS had applied for permission to trade Gazprom and was awaiting a decision from regulatory authorities.
